Resolves #20086

An application can now reveal a railed item over the dock layout and hold it open for as long as its own state needs it. The reveal leaves focus where it was, a press beside it no longer closes it, and the Workspace reports when the person ends it with `Escape` or the item's own tab. This is the entry neomjs/neo-agent-institution#791 needs: a card selection shows the Agent detail over the roster, instead of opening a column that moves every card.

- **`RevealStateMachine`** gains `revealed-held`, entered by `hold(itemId)` and left by `release(itemId)`. Pointer, focus, hover and outside inputs leave it alone. `escape()`, the item's own tab and `itemCleared` end it, as they end every reveal.
- **`Rail#reveal` / `#dismissReveal`** drive the held state for an item on that rail, and the outside-pointer listener stays off while it is held. `RevealOverlay.VISIBLE_STATES` draws it.
- **`Workspace#revealRailItem` / `#dismissRailReveal`** find the rail through `forEachDockRail`. The Workspace relays every rail reveal change as its own `dockRailRevealChange`, threaded through the projection context beside `onDockZoneDocumentChange`.
- **Docs:** ADR 0029 §2.7 gains the app-held reveal row, and its Status gains the amendment line. `DockLayoutsFeatures.md` names the new reveal beside the click and hover reveals.

Prescription checked: `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/RevealStateMachine.mjs` owns the concern. The machine owns every reveal input's policy, and `Rail.mjs` owns the listener and the focus move that policy gates. No consumer-side layer reaches either.

Evidence: L2 (unit + component tier in headless Chromium, red-first on `dev` sources) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-3; AC-4 is docs). Residual: none.

size-guard-growth: src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs — the app-held reveal's public entry (`revealRailItem`, `dismissRailReveal`, the `dockRailRevealChange` relay) belongs on the Workspace, the application's handle; its four members delegate to `Rail`, and no Workspace code is replaced

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered, in `DockRevealStateMachine.spec`: "an app hold reveals once, and no pointer, focus, hover or outside input ends it", "escape, its own tab, itemCleared and release each end a hold", "release ends a reveal of its own item only, and a hold on another item retargets", and "a hold supersedes a pending dwell and its wait". |
| AC-2 | CI-covered. `DockWorkspace.spec` "an app holds a railed item open through the workspace and hears every change of it" checks four things: the document stays unchanged, the relay carries its rail, an item on no rail returns `null`, and both the open and the end reach the Workspace. `DockRail.spec` "an app reveal holds without focus, operation or outside listener, and dismissReveal ends it" has a control: "the same harness sees a click reveal move focus and arm the outside listener". |
| AC-3 | CI-covered, in the component tier's `DockRailRevealHeld.spec` on the new fixture app `dock-rail-held`. A held reveal keeps focus outside and survives a click beside it. `Escape` inside it ends it, and the Workspace log reads `idle:`. The app lets go of it. Control: a rail-tab click still reveals with focus, and a click beside it dismisses. |
| AC-4 | The ADR 0029 Status line and the §2.7 row; the `DockLayoutsFeatures.md` paragraph. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **A seventh ledger row.** The ticket's ledger now has a row for the relay callback: the `LayoutAdapter.project` option and the `Rail` config `onDockRailRevealChange`. This is the threading the Fix's item 3 names, now a row of its own.
- **Two test hosts gain one member.** The duck-typed projection hosts in `DockFlip.spec` and `DockTabEnterButton.spec` now supply `onDockRailRevealChange`, as they supply every member the projection loop consults.
- **The Institution needs the same line.** The host in its `test/playwright/unit/apps/agentos/view/fleet/cockpit/projection.spec.mjs` needs this line once its lock moves to this engine. neo-agent-institution#791's PR bumps that lock and carries it.

## Test Evidence
- **Red-first, same instrument, with `src/` stashed on `dev` (`dcae85851f`):**
  - Unit: all six app-held arms fail, and the click-reveal control passes.
  - Component: the three held arms fail, and the control passes.
  - At head, every one of them passes.
- **A regression found and closed.** The first full head run of `unit/dashboard/` failed `DockFlip.spec` "uses dock item ids rather than component refs for projection marker identity" and `DockTabEnterButton.spec` "the refresh owner captures a globally absent addTab once; …". Their duck-typed hosts lacked the new member (`TypeError … reading 'bind'`), and that was fixed in the hosts (Deltas).
- **Base for comparison.** `unit/dashboard/` was clean in three of three runs with `src/` stashed. At head it is 1324 passed, 0 failed.
